verdict.rationale: Per-employee workstation compliance tracking is a fair axis for a compliance automation platform. However, the evidence never mentions a device agent, an MDM integration, or checks for disk encryption, screen lock, or password managers. Generic claims about integrations and continuous monitoring, plus the custom-integration API (a developer building block), do not show the product delivers this capability.

support.subject: As an IT admin, workstation compliance is tracked per employee — disk encryption, screen lock, password manager — via an agent or MDM integration
